openness.spatial_footprint: Existing source ribbon width and equivalent thickness; all ordered spans projected to each owner B-plane; overlaps counted once for coverage.

boundary_footprint.basis: Historical RIBBON_EDGE_2PASS footprint convention, used only to keep the architectural comparison basis. Does not assign a material, FE section or mass to the new boundary.

openness_contract.scope: Existing 500 reviewed native baselines only; fixed gap 1 m. Geometry metric joined after native boundary, ordered sleeve transfer, mass and length checks.
